001package com.streamConverter.benchmark;
002
003import com.streamConverter.CommandResult;
004import java.io.PrintWriter;
005import java.io.StringWriter;
006import java.time.Instant;
007import java.time.LocalDateTime;
008import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
009import java.util.*;
010import java.util.stream.Collectors;
011import org.slf4j.Logger;
012import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
013
014/**
015 * StreamConverterのパフォーマンス分析とレポート生成
016 *
017 * <p>このクラスは、CommandResultから詳細なパフォーマンス分析を行い、 実行時間、メモリ使用量、スループットなどの統計情報を提供します。
018 *
019 * <p>主な機能：
020 *
021 * <ul>
022 *   <li>実行時間の統計分析（平均、中央値、分散など）
023 *   <li>メモリ使用量の追跡と分析
024 *   <li>スループット計算とボトルネック識別
025 *   <li>コマンド別パフォーマンス比較
026 *   <li>詳細なレポート生成（テキスト、CSV形式）
027 * </ul>
028 */
029public class PerformanceAnalyzer {
030
031  private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PerformanceAnalyzer.class);
032
033  private final List<PerformanceRecord> records = new ArrayList<>();
034
035  /**
036   * CommandResult配列からパフォーマンス記録を追加
037   *
038   * @param testName テスト名
039   * @param results コマンド実行結果のリスト
040   * @param totalDataSize 処理したデータの総サイズ
041   */
042  public void addRecord(String testName, List<CommandResult> results, long totalDataSize) {
043    if (results == null || results.isEmpty()) {
044      logger.warn("Empty results provided for test: {}", testName);
045      return;
046    }
047
048    PerformanceRecord record = new PerformanceRecord(testName, results, totalDataSize);
049    records.add(record);
050
051    logger.debug("Added performance record: {} with {} commands", testName, results.size());
052  }
053
054  /** 全記録をクリア */
055  public void clearRecords() {
056    records.clear();
057  }
058
059  /**
060   * パフォーマンス統計を取得
061   *
062   * @return パフォーマンス統計情報
063   */
064  public PerformanceStatistics getStatistics() {
065    if (records.isEmpty()) {
066      logger.warn("No performance records available for statistics");
067      return new PerformanceStatistics();
068    }
069
070    return new PerformanceStatistics(records);
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * 詳細なパフォーマンスレポートを生成
075   *
076   * @return パフォーマンスレポートの文字列
077   */
078  public String generateDetailedReport() {
079    StringWriter writer = new StringWriter();
080    try (PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(writer)) {
081      generateDetailedReport(pw);
082    }
083    return writer.toString();
084  }
085
086  /**
087   * 詳細なパフォーマンスレポートを指定のPrintWriterに出力
088   *
089   * @param writer 出力先のPrintWriter
090   */
091  public void generateDetailedReport(PrintWriter writer) {
092    writer.println("StreamConverter Performance Analysis Report");
093    writer.println("==========================================");
094    writer.println(
095        "Generated: " + LocalDateTime.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME));
096    writer.println();
097
098    if (records.isEmpty()) {
099      writer.println("No performance data available.");
100      return;
101    }
102
103    PerformanceStatistics stats = getStatistics();
104
105    // サマリー情報
106    writer.println("EXECUTIVE SUMMARY");
107    writer.println("-----------------");
108    writer.printf("Total test runs: %d%n", records.size());
109    writer.printf("Average execution time: %.2f ms%n", stats.averageExecutionTime);
110    writer.printf("Average throughput: %.2f MB/s%n", stats.averageThroughput);
111    writer.printf("Peak memory usage: %.2f MB%n", stats.peakMemoryUsage / 1024.0 / 1024.0);
112    writer.printf("Total data processed: %.2f MB%n", stats.totalDataProcessed / 1024.0 / 1024.0);
113    writer.println();
114
115    // 個別テスト結果
116    writer.println("DETAILED TEST RESULTS");
117    writer.println("---------------------");
118
119    for (PerformanceRecord record : records) {
120      writer.printf("Test: %s%n", record.testName);
121      writer.printf("  Data size: %.2f MB%n", record.totalDataSize / 1024.0 / 1024.0);
122      writer.printf("  Total execution time: %d ms%n", record.totalExecutionTime);
123      writer.printf("  Throughput: %.2f MB/s%n", record.throughput);
124      writer.printf("  Commands: %d%n", record.results.size());
125      writer.printf("  Peak memory: %.2f MB%n", record.peakMemoryUsage / 1024.0 / 1024.0);
126
127      // コマンド別詳細
128      writer.println("  Command breakdown:");
129      for (int i = 0; i < record.results.size(); i++) {
130        CommandResult result = record.results.get(i);
131        writer.printf(
132            "    [%d] %s: %d ms (%.2f MB/s, %.2f MB memory)%n",
133            i + 1,
134            result.getCommandName(),
135            result.getExecutionTimeMillis(),
136            calculateThroughput(result, record.totalDataSize),
137            result.getInputBytes() / 1024.0 / 1024.0);
138      }
139      writer.println();
140    }
141
142    // 統計分析
143    writer.println("STATISTICAL ANALYSIS");
144    writer.println("--------------------");
145    writer.printf("Execution time statistics:%n");
146    writer.printf("  Min: %.2f ms%n", stats.minExecutionTime);
147    writer.printf("  Max: %.2f ms%n", stats.maxExecutionTime);
148    writer.printf("  Median: %.2f ms%n", stats.medianExecutionTime);
149    writer.printf("  Standard deviation: %.2f ms%n", stats.executionTimeStdDev);
150    writer.println();
151
152    writer.printf("Throughput statistics:%n");
153    writer.printf("  Min: %.2f MB/s%n", stats.minThroughput);
154    writer.printf("  Max: %.2f MB/s%n", stats.maxThroughput);
155    writer.printf("  Median: %.2f MB/s%n", stats.medianThroughput);
156    writer.printf("  Standard deviation: %.2f MB/s%n", stats.throughputStdDev);
157    writer.println();
158
159    // パフォーマンス推奨事項
160    generateRecommendations(writer, stats);
161  }
162
163  /**
164   * CSV形式のレポートを生成
165   *
166   * @return CSV形式のパフォーマンスレポート
167   */
168  public String generateCSVReport() {
169    StringWriter writer = new StringWriter();
170    try (PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(writer)) {
171      generateCSVReport(pw);
172    }
173    return writer.toString();
174  }
175
176  /**
177   * CSV形式のレポートを指定のPrintWriterに出力
178   *
179   * @param writer 出力先のPrintWriter
180   */
181  public void generateCSVReport(PrintWriter writer) {
182    // ヘッダー
183    writer.println(
184        "Test Name,Data Size (MB),Total Time (ms),Throughput (MB/s),Commands,Peak Memory (MB),Success Rate");
185
186    // データ行
187    for (PerformanceRecord record : records) {
188      writer.printf(
189          "%s,%.2f,%d,%.2f,%d,%.2f,%.2f%n",
190          record.testName,
191          record.totalDataSize / 1024.0 / 1024.0,
192          record.totalExecutionTime,
193          record.throughput,
194          record.results.size(),
195          record.peakMemoryUsage / 1024.0 / 1024.0,
196          record.successRate * 100.0);
197    }
198  }
199
200  /** パフォーマンス推奨事項を生成 */
201  private void generateRecommendations(PrintWriter writer, PerformanceStatistics stats) {
202    writer.println("PERFORMANCE RECOMMENDATIONS");
203    writer.println("---------------------------");
204
205    List<String> recommendations = new ArrayList<>();
206
207    // スループットに基づく推奨事項
208    if (stats.averageThroughput < 10.0) {
209      recommendations.add(
210          "Low throughput detected (< 10 MB/s). Consider optimizing I/O operations or reducing command overhead.");
211    }
212
213    // メモリ使用量に基づく推奨事項
214    double memoryToDataRatio = stats.peakMemoryUsage / (double) stats.totalDataProcessed;
215    if (memoryToDataRatio > 2.0) {
216      recommendations.add(
217          "High memory usage ratio detected (> 2x data size). Consider implementing streaming optimization.");
218    }
219
220    // 実行時間のばらつきに基づく推奨事項
221    double cvExecutionTime = stats.executionTimeStdDev / stats.averageExecutionTime;
222    if (cvExecutionTime > 0.3) {
223      recommendations.add(
224          "High execution time variability detected (CV > 30%). Consider investigating performance consistency.");
225    }
226
227    // コマンド数に基づく推奨事項
228    double avgCommandsPerTest =
229        records.stream().mapToInt(r -> r.results.size()).average().orElse(0.0);
230    if (avgCommandsPerTest > 5) {
231      recommendations.add(
232          "Complex pipelines detected (> 5 commands). Consider pipeline optimization or parallel processing.");
233    }
234
235    if (recommendations.isEmpty()) {
236      writer.println(
237          "No specific performance issues detected. Current performance is within acceptable ranges.");
238    } else {
239      for (int i = 0; i < recommendations.size(); i++) {
240        writer.printf("%d. %s%n", i + 1, recommendations.get(i));
241      }
242    }
243    writer.println();
244  }
245
246  /** スループットを計算 */
247  private double calculateThroughput(CommandResult result, long totalDataSize) {
248    if (result.getExecutionTimeMillis() <= 0) {
249      return 0.0;
250    }
251    return (totalDataSize / 1024.0 / 1024.0) / (result.getExecutionTimeMillis() / 1000.0);
252  }
253
254  /** パフォーマンス記録クラス */
255  private static class PerformanceRecord {
256    final String testName;
257    final List<CommandResult> results;
258    final long totalDataSize;
259    final long totalExecutionTime;
260    final double throughput;
261    final long peakMemoryUsage;
262    final double successRate;
263    final Instant timestamp;
264
265    PerformanceRecord(String testName, List<CommandResult> results, long totalDataSize) {
266      this.testName = testName;
267      this.results = new ArrayList<>(results);
268      this.totalDataSize = totalDataSize;
269      this.timestamp = Instant.now();
270
271      // 統計計算
272      this.totalExecutionTime =
273          results.stream().mapToLong(CommandResult::getExecutionTimeMillis).sum();
274
275      this.throughput =
276          totalExecutionTime > 0
277              ? (totalDataSize / 1024.0 / 1024.0) / (totalExecutionTime / 1000.0)
278              : 0.0;
279
280      this.peakMemoryUsage =
281          results.stream().mapToLong(r -> r.getInputBytes() + r.getOutputBytes()).max().orElse(0L);
282
283      long successCount = results.stream().mapToLong(r -> r.isSuccess() ? 1 : 0).sum();
284      this.successRate = results.size() > 0 ? (double) successCount / results.size() : 0.0;
285    }
286  }
287
288  /** パフォーマンス統計クラス */
289  public static class PerformanceStatistics {
290    /** 平均実行時間（ミリ秒） */
291    public final double averageExecutionTime;
292
293    /** 最小実行時間（ミリ秒） */
294    public final double minExecutionTime;
295
296    /** 最大実行時間（ミリ秒） */
297    public final double maxExecutionTime;
298
299    /** 中央値実行時間（ミリ秒） */
300    public final double medianExecutionTime;
301
302    /** 実行時間の標準偏差 */
303    public final double executionTimeStdDev;
304
305    /** 平均スループット（MB/s） */
306    public final double averageThroughput;
307
308    /** 最小スループット（MB/s） */
309    public final double minThroughput;
310
311    /** 最大スループット（MB/s） */
312    public final double maxThroughput;
313
314    /** 中央値スループット（MB/s） */
315    public final double medianThroughput;
316
317    /** スループットの標準偏差 */
318    public final double throughputStdDev;
319
320    /** 処理した総データサイズ（バイト） */
321    public final long totalDataProcessed;
322
323    /** ピークメモリ使用量（バイト） */
324    public final long peakMemoryUsage;
325
326    /** 全体の成功率 */
327    public final double overallSuccessRate;
328
329    /** 総テスト数 */
330    public final int totalTests;
331
332    /** 総コマンド数 */
333    public final int totalCommands;
334
335    PerformanceStatistics() {
336      // 空の統計（データなし）
337      this.averageExecutionTime = 0.0;
338      this.minExecutionTime = 0.0;
339      this.maxExecutionTime = 0.0;
340      this.medianExecutionTime = 0.0;
341      this.executionTimeStdDev = 0.0;
342
343      this.averageThroughput = 0.0;
344      this.minThroughput = 0.0;
345      this.maxThroughput = 0.0;
346      this.medianThroughput = 0.0;
347      this.throughputStdDev = 0.0;
348
349      this.totalDataProcessed = 0L;
350      this.peakMemoryUsage = 0L;
351      this.overallSuccessRate = 0.0;
352
353      this.totalTests = 0;
354      this.totalCommands = 0;
355    }
356
357    PerformanceStatistics(List<PerformanceRecord> records) {
358      this.totalTests = records.size();
359      this.totalCommands = records.stream().mapToInt(r -> r.results.size()).sum();
360
361      // 実行時間統計
362      List<Double> executionTimes =
363          records.stream()
364              .map(r -> (double) r.totalExecutionTime)
365              .sorted()
366              .collect(Collectors.toList());
367
368      this.averageExecutionTime =
369          executionTimes.stream().mapToDouble(Double::doubleValue).average().orElse(0.0);
370
371      this.minExecutionTime = executionTimes.isEmpty() ? 0.0 : executionTimes.get(0);
372      this.maxExecutionTime =
373          executionTimes.isEmpty() ? 0.0 : executionTimes.get(executionTimes.size() - 1);
374      this.medianExecutionTime = calculateMedian(executionTimes);
375      this.executionTimeStdDev = calculateStandardDeviation(executionTimes, averageExecutionTime);
376
377      // スループット統計
378      List<Double> throughputs =
379          records.stream().map(r -> r.throughput).sorted().collect(Collectors.toList());
380
381      this.averageThroughput =
382          throughputs.stream().mapToDouble(Double::doubleValue).average().orElse(0.0);
383
384      this.minThroughput = throughputs.isEmpty() ? 0.0 : throughputs.get(0);
385      this.maxThroughput = throughputs.isEmpty() ? 0.0 : throughputs.get(throughputs.size() - 1);
386      this.medianThroughput = calculateMedian(throughputs);
387      this.throughputStdDev = calculateStandardDeviation(throughputs, averageThroughput);
388
389      // その他の統計
390      this.totalDataProcessed = records.stream().mapToLong(r -> r.totalDataSize).sum();
391
392      this.peakMemoryUsage = records.stream().mapToLong(r -> r.peakMemoryUsage).max().orElse(0L);
393
394      this.overallSuccessRate =
395          records.stream().mapToDouble(r -> r.successRate).average().orElse(0.0);
396    }
397
398    private double calculateMedian(List<Double> sortedValues) {
399      if (sortedValues.isEmpty()) {
400        return 0.0;
401      }
402
403      int size = sortedValues.size();
404      if (size % 2 == 0) {
405        return (sortedValues.get(size / 2 - 1) + sortedValues.get(size / 2)) / 2.0;
406      } else {
407        return sortedValues.get(size / 2);
408      }
409    }
410
411    private double calculateStandardDeviation(List<Double> values, double mean) {
412      if (values.size() <= 1) {
413        return 0.0;
414      }
415
416      double sumSquaredDifferences =
417          values.stream().mapToDouble(value -> Math.pow(value - mean, 2)).sum();
418
419      return Math.sqrt(sumSquaredDifferences / (values.size() - 1));
420    }
421  }
422}
